resources.string: No sleep data yet: wear your watch or ring to bed, or tell Coach how you slept.
Hard training day: a little more sleep helps you recover.
You trained today: some extra rest helps.
You averaged %1$s a night this week: catch up gradually.
Heavy dinner at %1$s: give digestion about 2.5 hours before lying down (from %2$s on).

Adults usually need 7 to 9 hours. The app starts from what fits your age and adds time after a hard training day or a short week of sleep, then counts back from your usual wake-up time. Sleep comes from any watch, ring or app that shares it with Health Connect, or from what you tell Coach. It is advice, not a medical assessment.
Suggests how long to sleep and when to go to bed, from your training, late meals and recent sleep. Shown on Home and used by Coach.
